[[Controller/Legends|Controller]] '''Geles''' was a [[Lant Mining Corporation]] employee who worked at [[Lormar 23]] in the [[Mangez system/Legends|Mangez system]]. She worked in traffic control, coordinating incoming [[Starship/Legends|starships]].
